title: Personal Array of Firefox Preferences
description: An array of objects that each describe my personally set firefox preferences.

items.$comment: This schema will NOT invalidate duplicate preference-value definitions.

sync.description: Firefox Sync. Define additional preference of same name prepended with 'services.sync.prefs.sync.', set to the value of this boolean.

note.description: Define two additional preferences of same name, both appended with '.cgxx-note', one (dummy) set to value of this string, the other prepended with 'services.sync.prefs.sync.' set to the sync property value of this object. Purpose of dummy preference is for in-situ reference when browsing `about:config`.

examples.note: 2 => Download directory path defined by `browser.download.dir`. Not synced given potential differences between respective host filesystems. See: https://searchfox.org/firefox-main/source/browser/components/preferences/config/downloads.mjs#157
Enables the Browser Console for executing JavaScript expressions.
